symbols.read: Price has dropped to 729.00, extending the bearish structure below the 737.02 invalidation and pressing toward the 722.40 lower pivot, so the prior bearish-leaning read is confirmed rather than revised. The 1H downtrend holds with the last candle 734.23→731.12, and the bear FVGs at 737.63–738.00 and 745.09–746.32 remain intact overhead supply. The SELL setup is still pending, not triggered — 722.40 has not broken, so the 686.36 target stays contingent on that break. Bias remains bearish; invalidation is unchanged at a reclaim of 737.02 and the 745.09–746.32 FVG, while holding below 737.02 keeps 722.40 then 686.36 in play. Note the BULLISH regime flag conflicts with the bearish 4H/1H alignment, a caution against pressing shorts into the pivot.

The bearish lean is confirmed and extended once more: price has dropped from 81,754.71 to 81,396.01, the last 1H bar is down -0.24% (81,882.00→81,681.69), and the 1H trend stays down with the 4H bearish and combined 4H+1H reading at SELL. The BUY setup remains INVALIDATED — its 82,413.00 stop is well above current price, so the long is dead and the BULLISH regime tag is stale against the tape. The overhead bear FVG stack (82,267.79–82,465.00, 82,531.17–82,647.05, 83,015.23–83,403.64, 83,483.91–84,082.82) is unchanged and continues to cap any bounce, keeping bias bearish toward the 80,684.36 lower pivot. Invalidation of the bearish case still requires a full reclaim of the 83,713.91 pivot and the 83,484–84,082.82 gap; a first repair signal would be reclaiming 82,647 and then the 83,015–83,404 gap.

The bearish bias remains confirmed and has extended again: price at 2,382.99 is below the prior read's 2,403.73, with the 1H trend still down (2,413.23→2,398.91) and the combined 4H+1H signal still SELL. The 2,453.97–2,472.90 bear FVG remains the only open overhead supply, now more distant still, while the 2,329.00 lower pivot is the next downside magnet and the only thing standing between price and a deeper flush. The BUY setup (entry 2,478.00, stop 2,481.87, target 2,627.00) stays invalidated and irrelevant at this price, and the BULLISH regime tag remains stale and contradicted by structure. Invalidation of the bearish read still requires a reclaim of 2,478.00 and a close through the overhead FVG.

Price has slipped to 103.96 from 104.49, and the prior neutral-to-bearish stance has firmed back into a SELL as the combined 4H+1H read reverted to bearish with the 1H trend still down. The bull FVG at 104.33–104.45 that gave the bounce its foothold has been lost beneath price, and the bear stack has compressed to two gaps at 105.81–105.92 and 106.29–106.97, well below the prior 107.55–107.90 top — a lower overhead ceiling that keeps pressure on. Bias is bearish: 100.43 remains the downside magnet and 108.25 the upside pivot, with a hold above 108.25 still the invalidation that would neutralize the gaps and revive the 116.07 target. The BUY setup stays invalidated and moot at entry 108.25, far above price.

Price has broken below the 55.37 target to 55.15, extending the bearish leg and confirming the prior bias — the 1H trend stays down and combined remains SELL with 4H bearish. The overhead bear FVGs (56.79–56.96 and now 55.53–55.73) keep supply layered above, with the nearer gap marking the first resistance on any bounce. The short entry/stop cluster (58.41/58.58) remains EXPIRED and far above price, so the original entry is fully stale. Bias stays bearish; invalidation is unchanged — a sustained reclaim of 58.41 flips the read bullish toward 61.45.

Price extended the downside to 4,051.95, breaking below the prior 4,065.48 flipped-resistance pivot and confirming the bearish structure rather than exhausting it — the previous read's caution about a reclaim never triggered, so the bias stays bearish and the target-driven sell-off is still extending. Momentum cooled, though: the 1H leg decelerated to -0.19% from -0.50%, so this is drift lower, not acceleration, and the stacked bear FVGs at 4,126.37–4,130.31 and 4,131.15–4,132.33 remain untouched overhead supply far above price. With 4,065.48 now lost as support, it flips back to near-term resistance; holding below keeps pressure toward further extension, while a sustained reclaim above 4,065.48 would signal the sell-off is stalling. Invalidation for the bearish structural read sits at the 4,141.44 pivot — a push back above it would neutralize the setup entirely.

Bias stays bearish and the previous read is confirmed, not revised: combined 4H+1H remains SELL with the 4H bearish and the 1H trend down, and price has slipped from 1.33 to 1.32, extending the drift away from the 1.35 line in the sand rather than reclaiming it. The bear FVG at 1.3532–1.3633 is still the active overhead supply and 1.35 remains resistance, with the 1.26 lower pivot as the downside objective; the BUY entry at 1.35 with a 1.44 target has now expired and stays off the table. The only change from the prior read is the lower close at 1.32, which keeps the path to 1.26 open without yet testing it. Invalidation is unchanged: a reclaim of 1.3633 would be the first sign of repair, and a sustained hold below 1.33 keeps the bearish case intact.
